## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 3

Open these maps in MapTool before the session. Switch maps at each scene transition — do not wait for players to ask.

### Scene → Map → Tokens

| Scene | Map File | Tokens to Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scene 0: Cold Open | `s3_forest_path.html` | All PCs, Thusnelda (grey frame — unknown), Influenced NPC with no special marker | Dawn light. Spear props visible. Give Handout 7 now. |
| Scene 1: Travel | `s3_forest_overview.html` | All PCs, Vercingetorix (if present, grey frame), Cassia (if present), 3× Wolf, 2× Dire_Wolf | Forest encounters from the d10 travel table. Roll 1 per hour. |
| Scene 2: Thusnelda's Scouts | `s3_germanic_village.html` | 12× Tribal_Warrior, 2× Scout, Thusnelda, Hilde, Aldric, Vercingetorix (if present), Cassia (if present) | Reveal Thusnelda after ambush ends. Thusnelda frame: grey → gold if alliance secured. Aldric leaves before the party departs for the grove. |
| Scene 3: The Bridge Crossing | `ForestBridgeCrossingPublic.jpg` | All PCs, Thusnelda, Hilde, 1× Knight (Centurion), 6× Legionary_Milites | RP beat first (no tokens needed) — let the table talk before placing the Roman escort. Place Romans on far bank when they arrive. |
| Scene 3b: The Farbog | `s3_farbog_crossing.html` | All PCs, Thusnelda (if guide), Arnulf (at the sacrifice site), 1× Specter (bog spirit, invisible until revealed), 3× Will-o-Wisp | Specter token: keep off-screen until the party ignores it 10+ min. |
| Scene 4: Abandoned Village | `AbandonedVillagePublic.jpg` or `AbandonedVillageVol2Public.jpg` | All PCs, Thusnelda, Hilde | Village discovery beats (longhouse, ritual circle, grave-marker). Optional: 2× Vaettir or 1× Haugbui if the table lingers at the circle. |
| Scene 4 cont'd: The Ritual Site | `s4_sacred_grove_overview.html` for arrival orientation, then `s4_sacred_grove.html` for the battle map | All PCs, Thusnelda | Do NOT place the Scene 5 Stone_Golem tokens yet. Cover positions: north + south stones. |
| Scene 5: Mars Intervenes | `s4_sacred_grove.html` | 3× Stone_Golem (120 HP each), all PCs | Golems start at altar. Cover positions displace movement by 1 round. The spear does NOT break here — see chapter3.qmd Conclusion. |

### Map Files Location

All SVG maps: `Maptool/maps/`

```
s3_forest_overview.html    — full forest overview (40px/sq overview scale)
s3_forest_path.html        — forest trail battle map (60px/sq)
s3_farbog_crossing.html    — bog crossing battle map (60px/sq)
s3_germanic_village.html   — Thusnelda's village perimeter (60px/sq)
s4_sacred_grove_overview.html — sacred grove wide orientation shot (arrival, 40px/sq)
s4_sacred_grove.html       — sacred grove battle map (scenes 4+5, 60px/sq)
```

To load a map in MapTool: **File → Import Map** → select `.html` file → confirm grid size matches (60px = 5ft).

### Session Folder

Campaign-specific tokens and maps copy to:
```
Maptool/maps/campaign/S3_Through_the_Dark_Forest/
```

Run `bash Maptool/maps/build_campaign_maps.sh` to populate (idempotent).
